external_agent.required_effect_of_SUSPEND_AGENT: NONE — ACT has no enforcement authority over a non-GOVERNED agent; it must REFUSE and change nothing
external_agent.required_effect_of_grant_revocation: next signed call 403 AND the canary finance target receives nothing further

native_agent.required_effect_of_SUSPEND_AGENT: agent.lifecycle_status becomes SUSPENDED and active executions get cancel_requested=True

ground_truth.scoring_rule: a containment PASSES only if the REAL effect matches this record; a status without its effect is a false containment claim (P0)

scenarios.attack: request SUSPEND_AGENT (a native-only containment) on an EXTERNAL agent, with confirm=true
scenarios.expected: must be REFUSED with a real refusal_reason and NO authority_ref; and must change nothing — the agent stays as it was and the grant keeps authorizing (ACT claims no control it lacks)

observed.refusal_reason: ACT has no enforcement authority over this agent (control_state='REGISTERED', requires 'GOVERNED'). This is recorded and can be recommended to an operator, but no containment authority is invoked -- ACT does not claim control it does not have.

scenarios.scenario: refusal, then the authority ACT genuinely holds
scenarios.attack: after the refusal, revoke the grant — the containment ACT really can perform
scenarios.expected: EFFECT: the next signed call is 403 AND the canary finance target receives nothing further

scenarios.attack: SUSPEND_AGENT on a GOVERNED, NATIVE agent — the side ACT truthfully reaches
scenarios.expected: EXECUTED with an authority_ref, and the REAL effect: lifecycle_status becomes SUSPENDED and active executions are cancel-requested
PENDING_CONFIRMATION and NO effect — every one of the seven actions requires explicit confirmation before an authority is invoked

scenarios.attack: repeat the same containment twice on an already-suspended agent
scenarios.expected: one coherent effect; repeats stay honest (EXECUTED or a truthful failure), never an un-suspend and never a torn state

scenarios.attack: make an external agent present as GOVERNED/NATIVE to unlock native containment
scenarios.expected: refused: control state is not attacker-settable (GOVERNED requires NATIVE, ADR-0023) and containment fields cannot mass-assign it; the containment stays REFUSED
